name: ${NAME}
description: P3B-D fidelity: the Sigil Voice Engine on ${EP} (direct build) converting ${CLIP} with the voice in ${SLOT}, ${PITCH} F0, 40 ms blocks, the Low-latency preset with LEVERS_JSON, scored against the offline ceiling (${CEILING_MODE}) at the lead offsets ${OFFSETS_JSON} s with the ${ANALYZER} scorer (v1 metrics reported next to it). Used for (a) the content plan against the plain session (SIGIL_VC_CONTENT_PLAN off vs on: must stay within A/A noise), (b) the content context and content_norm A/B (SIGIL_VC_CONTENT_CONTEXT_MS, LEVERS_JSON {"content_norm": "on"}), (c) the content-encoder precision checks (CONTENT_VARIANT pins the ceiling's encoder; SIGIL_VC_INT8 the stream's). write_audio keeps the renditions for rescoring against one fixed ceiling.
